spans.text: Canary deployments must reach five percent of production traffic before promotion.
The rollback window for a failed canary is thirty minutes from the first alert.
Rollbacks are executed by the release engineer on duty and never automatically.
A production database migration requires two approvals: one from the owning team and one from platform reliability.
Migrations run only inside the Tuesday maintenance window, between 02:00 and 05:00.
Every migration must be reversible within one hour or it is rejected.
The weekly incident review is held on Thursday at 15:00 in the reliability room.
Severity one incidents escalate to the on-call pager within three minutes.
Incident timelines are recorded in the postmortem template, not in chat.
Raw telemetry exports are written to the telemetry-raw storage bucket each night.
Curated tables live in the analytics warehouse and are retained for eighteen months.
Access to telemetry-raw requires a service account, never a personal login.
The quarterly access review is owned by Platform Security and completed in the first week of the quarter.
Findings from the access review are tracked as tickets with a thirty day deadline.
Any exception to policy needs a written justification approved by the review board.
